rule_content:
title: PowerShell Download Cradle
status: stable
description: Detects execution of PowerShell download cradles mimicking remote script execution
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'Net.WebClient'
      - 'DownloadString'
  condition: selection
level: high
description: Detects execution of PowerShell download cradles mimicking remote script execution

rule_name: LSASS Process Memory Dump via Procdump
rule_content:
title: LSASS Dump via Procdump
status: stable
description: Detects dumping of LSASS memory using Sysinternals procdump
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\procdump.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '-ma'
      - 'lsass'
  condition: selection
level: critical
description: Detects dumping of LSASS memory using Sysinternals procdump
